info.name: Paw-M API — Full Collection V2.1
info.description:
Complete, production-grade Postman collection for the Paw-M Veterinary Clinic backend API.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}}  (default: http://localhost:3001)
Pre-request scripts auto-login and inject the session token.

Roles seeded: admin / payroll / staff
Credentials: admin/admin123  ·  payroll/payroll123  ·  staff/staff123

Test scripts verify status codes, response shape, and log JSON payloads to the console.

item.name: OPTIONS — CORS preflight
item.description: Browser OPTIONS preflight — should return 204 with CORS headers.

item.name: GET /api/auth/config
item.description: Check if any staff account exists. Returns { configured: boolean }.

item.name: POST /api/auth/login (admin)
item.description:
Log in as admin. Expects { ok: true, role: 'admin' }.
The pre-request script automatically runs this before protected routes.

item.name: POST /api/auth/login (wrong password — rate limit test)
item.description: Should return { ok: false }. Run 5 times to trigger lockout.

item.name: POST /api/auth/login (staff role)
item.description: Log in as staff — role: 'staff'. Limited dashboard access.

item.name: POST /api/auth/login (payroll role)
item.description: Log in as payroll — role: 'payroll'. Business ops access.

item.name: PUT /api/auth/credentials (change password)
item.description: Change admin password. WARNING: changes the real DB credential.

item.name: GET /api/health
item.description: Returns { status: 'ok', db: 'connected' }. Use this to verify the server is running.

item.name: GET /api/settings
item.description: Returns the active clinic settings including Google Places ID.

item.name: PATCH /api/settings (update name + currency)
item.description: Update partial clinic settings. Only sends the fields you want changed.

item.name: PATCH /api/settings (update InstaPay)
item.description: Set InstaPay account number shown at checkout.

item.name: PATCH /api/settings (full update)

item.description: Full seed reset for clinic settings (Egypt/EGP defaults from seed.js).

item.name: GET /api/doctors
item.description: List all doctors in the system.

item.name: POST /api/doctors (create)

body.raw:
{
  "id": "dr-tester-qa",
  "name": "Dr. QA Tester",
  "specialization": "Veterinary Testing",
  "experience": "15+ years",
  "rating": 4.9,
  "days": [
    "Mon",
    "Wed",
    "Fri"
  ],
  "bio": "A test doctor created by Postman collection.",
  "initials": "QT",
  "tags": [
    "Testing",
    "QA"
  ],
  "pets": [
    "Dog",
    "Cat"
  ]
}

item.description: Creates a new doctor. Requires name, rating 0-5. Optionally specify id.

item.name: PATCH /api/doctors/:id (update rating)
item.description: Update fields partially — only rating is sent.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test("rating updated", () => pm.expect(j.rating).to.eql(5));

item.name: DELETE /api/doctors/:id (cleanup)
item.description: Deletes the test doctor. Returns 204 on success.

item.name: DELETE /api/doctors/:id (not-found — 404)
item.description: Deleting a non-existent doctor returns 404.

item.name: GET /api/services
item.description: List all clinic services.

item.name: POST /api/services (create)
item.description: Creates a new service. slug must be unique.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test("201", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(201)); pm.test("slug", () => pm.expect(j.slug).to.eql('svc-qa-test'));

item.name: PATCH /api/services/:slug (update)
item.description: Partial update — only description changes.

item.name: DELETE /api/services/:slug (cleanup)
item.description: Cleanup test service. Returns 204.

item.name: DELETE /api/services/:slug (404)
item.description: Deleting a non-existent slug returns 404.

item.name: GET /api/products
item.description: List all products, newest first.

item.name: GET /api/products/:id (existing)
item.description: Fetch one product by ID.

item.name: GET /api/products/:id (404)
item.description: Fetches a non-existent product — expects 404.

item.name: POST /api/products (create valid)

body.raw:
{
  "id": "prod-qa-test",
  "name": "QA Test Product",
  "description": "A product created by Postman for regression testing.",
  "price": 19.99,
  "compareAtPrice": 24.99,
  "image": "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1589924691995-400dc9ecc119?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80",
  "category": "health",
  "petType": "both",
  "stock": 50,
  "featured": true
}

item.description: Creates a product. Price >=0, stock >=0 int, compareAtPrice >= price.

item.name: POST /api/products (validation: price negative)
item.description: Should fail with 400 because price is negative.

item.name: POST /api/products (validation: compareAt < price)
item.description: Should fail — compareAtPrice must >= price.

item.name: PATCH /api/products/:id (partial update)
item.description: Update price and stock only.

item.name: DELETE /api/products/:id (cleanup)
item.description: Cleans up test product.

item.name: PATCH /api/products/:id (404)
item.description: Updating a non-existent product returns 404.

item.name: GET /api/bookings
item.description: List all booking requests, newest first.

item.name: POST /api/bookings (create — full)

body.raw:
{
  "ownerName": "Postman QA",
  "phone": "+201234567890",

item.description: Creates a booking request. Returns the created record with auto-generated ID (REQ-xxx).

item.name: POST /api/bookings (validation: missing ownerName)
item.description: Missing required fields still returns 201 (server-side validation is lenient — slots are empty by default).

item.name: PATCH /api/bookings/:id/status (→ confirmed)
item.description: Transition booking to confirmed. Sends confirmation email if email is set.

item.name: PATCH /api/bookings/:id/status (→ cancelled)
item.description: Cancel the booking. Sends cancellation email.

item.name: PATCH /api/bookings/:id/status (invalid status — 400)
item.description: Bad status value returns 400.

item.name: PATCH /api/bookings/:id/archive
item.description: Soft-archive a booking (set archived=true).

item.name: DELETE /api/bookings/:id
item.description: Permanently deletes the booking. Returns 204.

item.name: DELETE /api/bookings/:id (404)
item.description: Deleting a missing booking returns 404.

item.name: GET /api/orders
item.description: List all customer orders.

item.name: GET /api/orders/track (valid)
item.description: Track an order by ID + phone. Query params required.

exec: const j=pm.response.json(); pm.test("may or may not find", () => { pm.expect(j).to.be.an('object'); }); console.log(j);

item.name: GET /api/orders/track (missing params — 400)
item.description: Missing orderId or phone returns 400.

item.name: POST /api/orders (create — cash, valid)
item.description:
Places an order with 1 line item. Payment status: 'unpaid' for cash.
Stocks are decremented atomically in a Prisma transaction.

item.name: POST /api/orders (validation: empty cart — 400)
item.description: Empty cart → 400 error.

item.name: PATCH /api/orders/:id/payment (→ paid)
item.description: Mark order as paid. Sends payment-success email.

item.name: PATCH /api/orders/:id/status (→ completed)
item.description: Mark order completed. Cancelling would restore stock.

item.name: PATCH /api/orders/:id/archive
item.description: Soft-archive the order.

item.name: DELETE /api/orders/:id (cleanup)
item.description: Permanently delete the test order.

item.name: GET /api/payments
item.description: List all payment records.

item.name: POST /api/payments (create — valid)
item.description: Records a clinic income payment. Amount > 0, date YYYY-MM-DD.

item.name: POST /api/payments (validation: no title — 400)
item.description: Missing title → 400.

item.name: PATCH /api/payments/:id
item.description: Update payment status and amount.

item.name: DELETE /api/payments/:id (cleanup)
item.description: Delete the test payment.

item.name: GET /api/reviews (all — admin)
item.description:
Returns ALL reviews (all statuses, all productIds). Google place reviews have productId='clinic'.
Response is ordered: pending first, then by date desc.

item.name: GET /api/products/:id/reviews (public — approved only)
item.description: Public endpoint — returns only approved reviews for a specific product.

item.name: POST /api/reviews (create product review — pending)
item.description: Customer submits a review. Status defaults to 'pending'. Must be approved in dashboard.

item.name: PATCH /api/reviews/:id (approve)
item.description: Dashboard approves a pending product review.

item.name: PATCH /api/reviews/:id (reject)
item.description: Dashboard rejects a review.

item.name: POST /api/reviews (validation: missing fields — 400)
item.description: Missing productId, rating, comment → 400.

item.name: POST /api/google/sync-reviews (requires API key)
item.description:
Sync Google Reviews into the review table (productId='clinic').
Requires googlePlacesKey set in ClinicSettings — currently blank in seed.
Expected: 400 if no API key configured, OR { synced: N, total: M } on success.

item.name: DELETE /api/reviews/:id (cleanup)
item.description: Delete the test review.

item.name: DELETE /api/reviews/:id (404)
item.description: Deleting a non-existent review returns 404.

item.name: GET /api/work-session (current)
item.description: Returns the currently open session, or null if checked out.

item.name: POST /api/work-session/check-in
item.description: Check in for a new shift. Auto-closes yesterday's session if open, archives finished bookings/orders.

item.name: POST /api/work-session/check-out
item.description: Check out of current shift. Archives all finished bookings & orders.

item.name: POST /api/work-session/check-out (not checked in — 400)
item.description: Checking out without an open session → 400.

item.name: GET /api/work-days (folder list)
item.description: Returns a list of day-folders with booking/order/payment counts and revenue.

item.name: GET /api/work-days/:date (day detail)
item.description: Returns all bookings, orders, payments, session, and audit logs for a specific date.

item.name: GET /api/work-days/:date (invalid format — 400)
item.description: Non-YYYY-MM-DD format returns 400.

item.name: GET /api/audit-logs
item.description: Returns last 300 audit log entries, newest first. Read-only.
